text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. One common type is supervised learning, where the computer uses training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. For example, if we want to teach a computer to recognize pictures of cats, we give it thousands of labeled photos. The computer builds a model by finding patterns in this data. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions on new, unseen images. The accuracy of the model tells us how often its predictions are correct. By improving the training data or adjusting the model, we can increase accuracy and make the predictions more reliable.
